title: Isolation of human and mouse myeloid-derived suppressor cells for metabolic analysis
protocol: Euthanize mice by IACUC-approved method.
Dissect away the skin to reveal the hind leg muscles.
Isolate both hind legs.
Palpate the hip socket to identify location and ensure femur is intact upon removal.
Cut along the length of the femur and tibia to remove the majority of the muscles.
Push forward on the hip socket to dislocate the femur and cut away the muscles and ligaments stabilizing the hips to detach the legs.
Isolate femur and tibia.
Dislocate the tibia from the ankle by repetitively hyperextending the joint.
Pull the muscle toward the patella to reveal the tibia.
Break off the fibula.
Dislocate the tibia from the patella by repetitively hyperextending the joint.
Place tibia in a petri dish containing sterile PBS.
Hold the patella and extend the joint to dislocate the femur from the patella.
Place the femur in a petri dish with sterile PBS.
Fill a sterile 15 mL conical tube with 15 mL of sterile PBS for collection.
Flush the bone marrow from the femur and tibia into the collection tube.
Cut off the hip-end of the femur.
Fill a 1 mL tuberculin syringe with a 27G needle with 600 μL of sterile PBS from the collection tube.
Insert the sterile PBS-filled syringe into the cut end of the femur and flush out the bone marrow with 600 μL of PBS into the collection tube.
Refill the needle with 600 μL of PBS from the collection tube and flush the femur an additional time.
Cut off the ankle-end of the tibia.
Insert the PBS-filled syringe into the cut end of the tibia and flush with 600 μL of PBS into the collection tube.
Repeat flushing until all bones are flushed.
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend in 3 mL sterile ACK lysis buffer for 1 min at room temperature.
Neutralize with 10 mL of sterile PBS.
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM for 5 min.
Spin down blood from healthy volunteer or patient donors at 1,500 RPM for 5 minutes.
Resuspend blood cell pellet in 4 ml of PBS.
Pipette the cell suspension slowly on top of the aliquoted LymphoprepTM at a 45° angle to overlay the samples without mixing.
Centrifuge at 2,000 RPM for 20 minutes at room temperature without brakes.
Carefully pipette the white middle layer containing leukocytes into a new sterile 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM for 5 minutes.
Aspirate off supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL of sterile PBS.
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM for 5 minutes.
Repeat steps 23 and 24 for an additional wash.
Resuspend in 1 mL of sterile MDSC-generation media.
Plate cells at a density of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in 2 mL per well in a 24-well plate using MDSC-Derivation Media.
Add final concentration of 10 μM isoproterenol or PBS to the wells.
Place plates in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 6 additional days.
Replenish media and isoproterenol every 2–3 days.
Resuspend cells into 15 mL conical tubes after detachment using Detachin Cell Detachment Solution according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Spin down the cell suspension at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of MDSC-generation media.
Plate the resuspended cells in a fresh 24-well plate.
Sort derived MDSCs to ensure consistent sample quality.
Harvest cells into sterile 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tubes with caps.
Detach adherent cells using Detachin Cell Detachment Solution.
Centrifuge the sample at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant by aspiration.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of sterile PBS.
Quantify the resuspended cells.
Set aside 0.1–1 × 10^6 cells in a new non-sterile 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tube for flow cytometric evaluation of sort efficacy.
Isolate MDSCs using STEMCELL magnetic isolation kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Resuspend the isolated cells in 1 mL sterile PBS.
Quantify the resuspended cells again.
Set aside another 0.1–1 × 10^6 cells into a new non-sterile 5 mL round-bottom polystyrene tube for flow cytometric evaluation of sort efficacy.
Isolate appropriate number of cells for metabolic analysis in a sterile 15 mL conical tube.
Proceed to step 58 for Fatty Acid Oxidation Analysis.
Proceed to step 79 if Oxidative Phosphorylation Analysis without FAO analysis is desired.
Proceed to step 93 for Glycolysis Analysis.
Centrifuge samples from steps 32 and 37 at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 min.
Resuspend in 100 μL PBS + 0.5 μL/1 × 10^6 cells FcBlock.
Stain at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Add 100 μL PBS + 0.5 μL/1 × 10^6 cells of antibodies to each sample.
Stain at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 20 min, protected from light.
Add 1 mL of PBS to each sample to dilute excess antibodies.
Centrifuge sample at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 min.
Resuspend samples in 200 μL of flow buffer.
Characterize MDSCs on available flow cytometer.
Use single-color controls using beads to set up appropriate compensation matrix prior to data collection.
Coat XF96 Cell culture microplate with Cell-Tak.
Add 20 μL of Cell-Tak solution into each well.
Cover the plate and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Rinse wells with sterile, tissue culture grade water.
Aspirate to remove residual solution.
Add 100 μL of sterile, tissue culture grade water to each well.
Aspirate to remove the water.
Cover the plate and let it dry for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Tightly cover plate with parafilm.
Store plate at 4°C until use or for up to 2 weeks.
Rehydrate Agilent Seahorse sensor cartridge by submerging in sterile, tissue culture grade water.
Open a sensor cartridge pack from the Agilent Flux Pack.
Separate the utility plate and sensor cartridge.
Rest sensor cartridge upside down next to the utility plate.
Add 200 μL of sterile, tissue culture grade water into each well of the utility plate.
Carefully replace the sensor cartridge onto the utility plate to submerge the sensors in the water.
Place the setup in a humidified, non-CO2, 37°C incubator overnight (usually 12–18 h).
Place 25 mL/plate of XF Calibrant in a 50 mL conical tube.
Place the XF Calibrant in a humidified, non-CO2, 37°C incubator overnight (usually 12–18 h).
Remove pre-warmed XF Calibrant and sensor cartridge from incubator.
Remove sensor cartridge from utility plate.
Set down sensor cartridge upside down.
Aspirate off the water from the utility plate.
Add 200 μL of pre-warmed XF Calibrant in each well of the utility plate.
Carefully replace the sensor cartridge onto the utility plate to submerge the sensors.
Place the utility plate in a humidified, non-CO2, 37°C incubator for 1 h prior to assay.
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in substrate limiting media (SLM) with 10 μM Isoproterenol/PBS or desired treatment.
Plate cells at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in 24 well plates.
Incubate the plated cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 24 h.
Harvest cells from plates according to steps 29ai and 29aii.
Centrifuge at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g) for 5 min.
Resuspend samples in 1 mL of 1× KHB Assay Working Solution pre-warmed to 37°C.
Quantify cells.
Dilute and plate cells at 1 × 10^5 cells in 150 μL of 1× KHB Assay Working Solution with 10 μM Isoproterenol/PBS or desired treatment on Cell-Tak coated 96-well flat-bottom plates from step 62.
Plate at least 6 wells/sample to ensure triplicate in each Palmitate-BSA vs BSA exposure condition.
Leave one well at each corner of the plate blank, containing only 180 μL of the 1× KHB Assay Working Solution without any cells for machine calibration.
Allow cells to adhere to the plate.
Incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 45 min.
Spin down plates for 5 min at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g).
Sit in non-CO2 37°C incubator for 10 min.
Load assay compounds into injection ports on the sensor cartridge from step 57.
Resuspend provided compounds from the kit in the volume of 1× KHB working assay solution specified in the user manual.
Prepare 2–3 mL of working solution according to the user manual to make a 10× working solution.
Load 100–200 μL of 10× working solution into the designated ports.
Optionally, add 20 μM Hoechst stain with the last injection for cell density normalization.
If performing cell normalization, obtain a pre-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Prepare Seahorse XFe 96 Extracellular Flux Analyzer.
Design experimental template using the Standard Substrate Oxidation Stress Test Assay template in Wave software.
Add 30 μL of Palmitate-BSA (1 mM Palmitate conjugated to 0.17 mM BSA) or BSA (0.17 mM) to appropriate sample wells.
Inject 100 μM etomoxir (ETX).
Inject 2 mM Oligomycin.
Inject 1 mM carbonyl cyanide 4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenylhydrazone (FCCP).
Inject 1 mM Rotenone and 1 mM Antimycin A.
Run samples on Seahorse XFe 96 Extracellular Flux Analyzer.
Click “Open tray” and load cell plate without the lid.
Click “Load Cell Plate” to run the assay.
If performing cell normalization, normalize the data to cell count.
Obtain post-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Calculate each well’s live cell count.
Click “Normalize”.
Enter live cell count into the Normalization grid.
Set Normalization Unit as Cells.
Click “Apply”.
Export data from the Wave software into GraphPad Prism format.
Graph the individual OCR measurements for each treatment condition.
Calculate the average OCR of the sample triplicates per treatment condition.
Calculate the FAO contribution, defined as OCRbaseline - OCR+ETX.
Resuspend cells in OCR medium pre-warmed to 37°C.
Plate at 1 × 10^5 cells in 180 μL in Cell-Tak coated 96-well flat-bottom plates.
Leave one well at each corner blank with only 180 μL of OCR medium for machine calibration.
Incubate the plate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 45 minutes.
Spin down plates for 5 minutes at 1,500 RPM (about 505 × g).
Sit plates in a non-CO2 incubator at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Load assay compounds into injection ports on the sensor cartridge.
Resuspend provided compounds from the kit in the volume of OCR medium specified in the user manual.
Prepare 2–3 mL of working solution according to the user manual to make a 10× working solution.
Load 100–200 μL of 10× working solution into designated ports.
Optional: Add 20 μM Hoechst stain with last injection for cell density normalization.
If performing cell normalization, obtain a pre-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Prepare Seahorse XFe 96 Extracellular Flux Analyzer.
Design experimental template on Wave software.
Update plate map on Wave software.
Obtain 3 measurements of baseline oxygen consumption rate (OCRbasal) using Seahorse XFe24 Analyzer.
Inject 2 mM Oligomycin to inhibit mitochondrial complex V.
Obtain 3 OCR measurements after Oligomycin injection.
Inject 1 mM FCCP to induce maximal respiration.
Obtain 3 OCR measurements after FCCP injection.
Inject 1 mM Rotenone and 1 mM Antimycin A to inhibit the electron transport chain.
Obtain 3 OCR measurements after Rotenone and Antimycin A injection.
Run calibration on Seahorse XFe24 Analyzer.
Insert sensor cartridge when prompted during calibration process.
Click “I’m Ready” to start calibration.
Load cell plate without lid into Seahorse XFe96 Extracellular Flux Analyzer.
Click “Load Cell Plate” to run the assay.
Normalize data to cell count if performing cell normalization, otherwise skip this step.
Obtain post-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Calculate live cell count for each well.
Enter live cell count into Normalization grid.
Set normalization unit as Cells.
Click “Apply”.
Export data from Wave software into GraphPad Prism format.
Graph individual OCR measurements for each treatment condition.
Calculate average OCR of sample triplicates per treatment condition.
Using the average OCR, calculate ATP Production as OCRbasal - OCR+Oligomycin.
Using the average OCR, calculate Maximal Respiratory Capacity as OCR+FCCP - OCR+Antimycin A/Rotenone.
Warm Cell-Tak coated 96-well flat bottom plate to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge samples at 1,500 RPM for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in ECAR medium prewarmed to 37°C.
Plate 1 × 10^5 cells in 180 μL of ECAR medium in Cell-Tak coated 96-well flat-bottom plates.
Leave one well at each corner blank, containing only 180 μL of the ECAR medium for machine calibration.
Allow cells to adhere to the plate.
Incubate at room temperature for 45 min.
Spin down plates for 5 minutes at 1,500 RPM.
Sit in non-CO2 37°C incubator for 10 minutes.
Resuspend provided compounds from the kit according to the user manual volume of ECAR medium specified.
Prepare 2–3 mL of working solution to make a 10× working solution.
Load 100–200 μL of 10× working solution into designated ports.
Optionally, add 20 μM Hoechst stain with the last injection for cell density normalization.
If performing cell normalization, obtain a pre-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Prepare Seahorse XFe 96 Extracellular Flux Analyzer.
Design experimental template and update plate map on Wave software.
Obtain 3 measurements of non-glycolytic extracellular acidification rate (ECARnon-glycolytic).
Inject 10 mM Glucose to induce glycolysis.
Obtain 3 ECAR measurements.
Inject 2 mM Oligomycin to inhibit mitochondrial complex V and induce maximal glycolysis.
Obtain 3 ECAR measurements.
Inject 100 mM 2-Deoxy-glucose (2-DG) to inhibit glycolysis.
Obtain 3 ECAR measurements.
Run calibration.
Click “Run”.
Insert sensor cartridge from step 98 when prompted.
Click “I’m Ready”.
Load cell plate without the lid.
Click “Load Cell Plate” to run the assay.
Normalize data to cell count if performing cell normalization.
Skip this step if not normalizing to cell count.
Obtain post-run brightfield and fluorescence image of each well.
Calculate live cell count for each well.
Click “Normalize”.
Enter live cell count into the Normalization grid.
Set Normalization Unit as Cells.
Click “Apply”.
Export data from Wave software into GraphPad Prism format.
Graph individual ECAR measurements for each treatment condition.
Calculate average ECAR of sample triplicates per treatment condition.
Calculate rate of glycolysis using ECAR+glucose – ECARnon-glycolytic.
Calculate glycolytic capacity using ECAR+Oligomycin - ECAR+2-DG.
